Background | Information

Context Import | High | temperature | warning, | that | is, | a | high | temperature | warning | issued | when | the | highest | temperature | is | expected | to | be | higher | than | 35 | ° | C | in | a | certain | period | of | time | in | the | future | . | It | is | to | arouse | people's | vigilance | and | do | a | good | job | of | heatstroke | prevention | and | cooling | in | time | .

Context Import | There | are | some | differences | in | the | heat | warnings | issued | by | each | country, | but | they | can | be | roughly | divided | into | the | following | three | levels | : | (1) High temperature yellow warning signal | Standard | : | The | daily | maximum | temperature | will | be | above | 35 | ° | C | for | three | consecutive | days | . | ( | 2 | ) | High | temperature | orange | warning | signal | Standard | : | The | highest | temperature | will | rise | above | 37 | ° | C | within | 24 | hours | . | ( | 3 | ) | High | temperature | red | warning | signal | Standard | : | The | highest | temperature | will | rise | above | 40 | ° | C | within | 24 | hours | .

Context Import | The | temperature | alarm | is | an | instrument | that | uses | a | temperature | sensor | to | detect | the | temperature | of | the | outside | world | in | real | time | . | When | the | temperature | exceeds | or | falls | below | a | critical | value | set | by | the | user, | an | alarm | is | sent | to | the | outside | world | .
Knowledge | Introduction

New Knowledge | | | Temperature and Humidity Sensor | The | temperature | and | humidity | sensor | is | a | digital | sensor | used | to | detect | temperature | and | humidity | . | The | temperature | and | humidity | detection | modules | are | integrated | in | a | small | cube | module, | which | can | work | stably | for | a | long | time | . | The | temperature | detection | range | is | - | 40 | ° | C | to | 125 | ° | C | ; | the | humidity | detection | range | is | 0 | to | 100 | % | RH | .

New Knowledge | | | Temperature and Humidity Sensor | There | is | an | integrated | module | at | the | front | end | of | the | temperature | and | humidity | sensor, | which | has | integrated | heat | - | sensitive | and | humidity | - | sensitive | elements | . | The | temperature | and | humidity | signals | can | be | collected, | and | after | being | processed | by | the | built | - | in | circuit, | they | can | be | converted | into | current | signals | or | voltage | signals | that | are | linearly | related | to | temperature | and | humidity | for | output | . | Temperature and | Humidity Sensor | Integrated modules | Sensor panel cover

New Knowledge | | | Temperature and Humidity Sensor | Read the temperature or humidity detected by the temperature and humidity sensor | Parameter value: 1 | - | 8, sensor connection port | Parameter value: 0 | - | 1, respectively temperature and humidity
